name: compathee n8n workflows
install: set -euo pipefail; for tool in jq curl git; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || { echo "missing required tool: $tool" >&2; exit 1; }; done; for f in workflows/*.json; do jq -e '.nodes and .connections and .name' "$f" >/dev/null; done; echo 'workflow JSON validated'
